description: This is the main React component file for the notes application frontend, responsible for rendering the home page layout, managing note selection, and handling editing modes.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders the notes application's home page, including sidebar, note viewing, editing, and CRUD controls.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates a new note with default title and content, selects it, and switches to edit mode.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Switches the mode to 'edit' to enable editing the selected note.

methods.name: onDone
methods.description: Switches the mode back to 'view' after editing.
